attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Bonecutter Gang maintains two settlements for their own purposes.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"for their own purposes\" adds an unreported motive; the briefing gives only the settlement count"},{"span":"the Ashford Compact clings to five","severity":"minor","reason":"\"clings\" implies the Compact is hard-pressed, a status the briefing does not report"},{"span":"It is a quiet stretch of time for everyone involved.","severity":"minor","reason":"claims quiet for everyone, but the briefing says only that the reporter heard nothing new"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"Accurate on the faction numbers and framed as a quiet week, but the wit is thin and generic, and the second item is padded and repeats the quiet-stretch line. A few small embellishments (\"clings\", \"for their own purposes\") add implied facts, and the Tribe and the war are barely used.\n"}
